title: Canonical geometry and maps for the Kummer lines
statement: For a field k, define C_false=Spec k[t] and C_true=Spec k[t,t^-1], their standard maps to Spec k, the inclusion induced by k[t] to k[t,t^-1], scalar maps to global functions via GammaSpecIso, the Laurent coordinate unit t, its actual Kummer boundary when m is invertible, and root restriction using the canonical inverse-image comparison. These are the existing definitions formerly in KummerAffineLine, with identical names, signatures and bodies.
